description: A made-up scenario built for conflict: three named apartments, where each side's favorite is ruled out by something only the other knows.
title: Choose an apartment to share
event: an apartment to share, and the move into it
opening_line: Hi! I'm so excited we're going to be roommates. We need to pick an apartment, a move-in date, and how we'll move our things. Which apartment do you like?
settle_example: So, Oak Avenue for the apartment?
closing_line: That's everything decided, then. Thanks for sorting this out with me, I can't wait to move in!

participant.brief: You and your friend are about to become roommates, and you have narrowed it down to three apartments: Maple Street (the cheapest), Oak Avenue (the biggest), and River Road (the newest). You like Maple Street best. Decide together.

constraints.text: Oak Avenue is a fourth-floor walk-up, and your bad knee can't manage the stairs.
Your lease ends on the 10th, so you have to be moved out by then.
Because of your knee, you can't carry heavy boxes.

avatar.brief: You and the user, a friend of yours, are about to become roommates, and you are choosing between three apartments: Maple Street (the cheapest), Oak Avenue (the biggest), and River Road (the newest). You like Oak Avenue best: suggest it early, and give it up only when the user gives you a reason.

constraints.text: You have a cat, and Maple Street doesn't allow pets.
You're away for work until the 6th.
Your brother will lend you his van for the move, but only on Sunday the 9th.
